name: Hyperboloid tower
_about: A TOWER DRAWN IN AT A WAIST: a ruled surface Gaudi built in brick and dressed in trencadis -- the administration pavilion's at Park Guell, white and blue in a chequer, 'the typical cross of four arms' on its domed crown. r0 at the foot, rw at the waist, r1 at the top; the shaft and crown take their own finishes.

params._h: the shaft's height from where it stands (the crown and cross go on top); r0, rw, r1: radii at foot, waist (at waistAt of h) and top
params._cross: yes: Gaudi's cross on the crown, crossH tall
params._t: the crown's tip, where the cross stands

shaft._about: the shaft: a hyperboloid of one sheet, drawn in to rw at waistAt of its height, flaring to r1 at the top

crown._about: the domed crown the cross stands on

cross._about: Gaudi's cross on the crown (cross: no leaves it off)
